content: Womu ɡe Dɑfidi u Yedutum kɑ wom kowobun wiruɡii kuɑ. Ge wee.

content.text: Kɑ ɡeemɑ, Gusunɔ wunɛ sɔɔrɑ nɛn nɑɑnɛ wɑ̃ɑ.
Wunɑ ɑ rɑ mɑn fɑɑbɑ ko.
Wunɑ ɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn kperu tèn mi nɑ rɑ kuke n kɑ fɑɑbɑ wɑ.
Wunɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn kuku yee bɑkɑru.
A ǹ derimɔ nɛn nɑɑsu su sokurɑ.
Sere sɑɑ yerɑ̀ i ko i n tɔnu kunisi i n sɛ̃re,
nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑ ɡɑnɑ ye yɑ dɛburɑ sure,
ǹ kun mɛ kɑrɑ ye yɑ wɔrumɑɑ dɔɔ.
Geemɑ, bɑ nɔɔ tiɑ mɔ̀
bu kɑ durɔ wi surɑ win ɑye bɑkɑrun di.
Bɑ ku rɑ n weesu mɛɛrɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu ben mi.
Kɑ nɔɔwɑ bɑ rɑ n tɔnu domɑru kuɑmmɛ,
ɡɔ̃ruɔ kpɑ bɑ n nùn bɔ̃rusimɔ.
Gusunɔ, wunɛ sɔɔrɑ nɛn nɑɑnɛ wɑ̃ɑ.
Wunɛ sɔɔrɑ nɛn yĩiyɔbu wɑ̃ɑ.
Wunɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn kperu tèn mi kon kuke n kɑ fɑɑbɑ wɑ.
Wunɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn kuku yee bɑkɑru.
Nɛn nɑɑsu kun mɑɑ sokurɑmɔ.
Gusunɔ, wunɑ ɑ rɑ mɑn fɑɑbɑ ko, kpɑ ɑ de nɑ n bɛɛrɛ mɔ.
Wunɑ nɛn kuku yee dɑmɡiru.
Bɛɛ tɔmbu, i nùn nɑɑnɛ koowo sɑɑ kpuro.
I nùn sɔ̃ɔwɔ ye yɑ bɛɛ nɛni.
Domi wiyɑ u sɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn kuku yeru.
Tɔnu u sɑ̃ɑwɑ wom dirum.
Mɛyɑ u mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ weesu.
Bɑ̀ n nùn kilo sɔndi, kɑɑ deemɑ u ǹ woo bunum turɑ.
I ku bɛɛn nɑɑnɛ doke dɑɑ bɔɔbɔyɑ sɔɔ.
I ku mɑɑ bɛɛn yĩiyɔbu doke wɔbiɑ sɔɔ.
Bɛɛn dukiɑ yɑ̀ n kuurɑmɔ, i ku bɛɛn bwɛ̃rɑ kpuro doke ye sɔɔ.
N ǹ nɔn teeru nɑ Gusunɔn ɡere yeni nuɑ ye u nɛɛ, wiyɑ u dɑm mɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɑ ɑ durom mɔ.
A rɑ bɑɑwure kɔsiewɑ ye u kuɑ.
